svg.title: A LoRA adapter is a small update to a frozen weight matrix
svg.desc: LoRA leaves a frozen weight matrix W untouched and adds a low-rank update: W prime equals W plus B times A, where B and A are thin matrices of rank 16. Fine-tuning finds A and B by gradient descent on action-labelled demonstrations. WIZARD generates them directly from an instruction and a visual demonstration through the frozen pi0.5 encoder and the HyperConvVLA generator. The rank-16 adapter has 46.1 million parameters, about 1.27 percent of the parameters considered in the scaling analysis, and is generated in about 70 milliseconds using 1.74 GB on an A6000.
